value.rationale: The Yost lower average-distance index for an elementary mixed Hilbertian–supremum space is a natural functional-analysis invariant motivated by Abrahamsen et al 2014 and Papini 2001. Reducing its infinite-dimensional finite-family supremum to a compact one-dimensional game plus an arbitrary-accuracy certified LP provides a reusable computable classification of a previously uncalculated natural case, and shows a quantitative separation from t(X). This is not a routine renaming, an unmotivated finite slice, or mere recomputation of µ1(c0); key dual adversarial geometry and nontrivial uniform approximation are essential.
